weather_report:
Before dawn in Subiaco the air is still and honest, the sky a polished pane with the last stars thinning at the edges. It feels clear enough to hear your own footsteps, cool enough to make the first breath feel clean. With a cloudless horizon waiting for the sun, visibility will be crisp once the light arrives, the kind of morning where colors sharpen and shadows have tidy edges.

Expect a bright, uncomplicated day to unfold from this clear start. Sunshine will come on quickly after sunrise, and the UV will ramp from gentle to unforgiving by late morning, so think light layers now, shedding to short sleeves, with a wide-brim hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen as standard kit. It looks pleasantly dry and glare-bright rather than heavy, better for ambling than lingering in bare light. An early walk to the corner café, a quick loop on the bike while the streets are yawning awake, watering the garden or hanging the wash before the sun gets fierce—these suit the mood. Run small errands in the morning, then move your desk or lunch to a patch of shade and let the day gleam around you while you keep to the cool.
